SELECT sp.name_raw, tsn.company_id, count(*) n
FROM sponsors sp
JOIN trial_sponsors_norm tsn ON tsn.nct_id = sp.nct_id AND tsn.role='lead'
WHERE sp.name_raw IN ('Celgene','Celgene Corporation') AND sp.role='lead'
GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT sp.name_raw, count(DISTINCT sp.nct_id) n, count(DISTINCT sp.nct_id) FILTER (WHERE tc.condition_key='D009101') n_mm
FROM sponsors sp
LEFT JOIN trial_conditions_norm tc ON tc.nct_id = sp.nct_id AND tc.condition_key='D009101'
WHERE sp.name_raw IN ('Celgene','Celgene Corporation') AND sp.role='lead'
GROUP BY 1

WITH celgene_trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sp.nct_id
  FROM sponsors sp
  WHERE sp.name_raw IN ('Celgene','Celgene Corporation') AND sp.role='lead'
)
SELECT
  count(DISTINCT t.nct_id) AS n_trials_mm,
  count(DISTINCT t.nct_id) FILTER (WHERE t.program_exists) AS n_active_trials_mm,
  count(DISTINCT t.nct_id) FILTER (WHERE t.is_active_readout) AS n_recruiting_mm,
  max(t.phase_rank) AS max_phase,
  count(DISTINCT ta.asset_id) AS n_assets
FROM celgene_trials ct
JOIN v_trials t ON t.nct_id = ct.nct_id
JOIN trial_conditions_norm tc ON tc.nct_id = ct.nct_id AND tc.condition_key='D009101'
LEFT JOIN trial_assets ta ON ta.nct_id = ct.nct_id AND ta.role IN ('subject','unknown')

WITH celgene_trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sp.nct_id
  FROM sponsors sp
  WHERE sp.name_raw IN ('Celgene','Celgene Corporation') AND sp.role='lead'
)
SELECT list(DISTINCT t.nct_id) AS ncts
FROM celgene_trials ct
JOIN v_trials t ON t.nct_id = ct.nct_id
JOIN trial_conditions_norm tc ON tc.nct_id = ct.nct_id AND tc.condition_key='D009101'

WITH celgene_trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sp.nct_id
  FROM sponsors sp
  WHERE sp.name_raw IN ('Celgene','Celgene Corporation') AND sp.role='lead'
)
SELECT count(*) n_bms_only_trials, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.program_exists) n_active
FROM v_sponsor_condition sc
JOIN v_trials t ON false  
WHERE false

WITH celgene_trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sp.nct_id
  FROM sponsors sp
  WHERE sp.name_raw IN ('Celgene','Celgene Corporation') AND sp.role='lead'
),
bms_mm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM trial_sponsors_norm WHERE role='lead' AND company_id='bristol myers squibb'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM trial_conditions_norm WHERE condition_key='D009101'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM bms_mm) AS bms_all_mm_trials,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM bms_mm WHERE nct_id IN (SELECT nct_id FROM celgene_trials)) AS bms_mm_via_celgene,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM bms_mm WHERE nct_id NOT IN (SELECT nct_id FROM celgene_trials)) AS bms_mm_true_bms

WITH celgene_trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sp.nct_id
  FROM sponsors sp
  WHERE sp.name_raw IN ('Celgene','Celgene Corporation') AND sp.role='lead'
),
mm AS (SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM trial_conditions_norm WHERE condition_key='D009101'),
bms_true AS (
  SELECT t.nct_id FROM v_trials t
  JOIN trial_sponsors_norm tsn ON tsn.nct_id=t.nct_id AND tsn.role='lead' AND tsn.company_id='bristol myers squibb'
  JOIN mm ON mm.nct_id=t.nct_id
  WHERE t.nct_id NOT IN (SELECT nct_id FROM celgene_trials)
),
celgene_only AS (
  SELECT t.nct_id FROM v_trials t JOIN celgene_trials ct ON ct.nct_id=t.nct_id JOIN mm ON mm.nct_id=t.nct_id
)
SELECT 'BMS (non-Celgene-branded)' AS grp, count(*) n_trials,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.program_exists) n_active,
  count(DISTINCT ta.asset_id) n_assets, max(t.phase_rank) max_phase
FROM bms_true t
LEFT JOIN trial_assets ta ON ta.nct_id=t.nct_id AND ta.role IN ('subject','unknown')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Celgene-branded (BMS subsidiary)', count(*),
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.program_exists),
  count(DISTINCT ta.asset_id), max(t.phase_rank)
FROM celgene_only t
LEFT JOIN trial_assets ta ON ta.nct_id=t.nct_id AND ta.role IN ('subject','unknown')

mm AS (SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM trial_conditions_norm WHERE condition_key='D009101'),
bms_true AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.nct_id FROM v_trials t
  JOIN trial_sponsors_norm tsn ON tsn.nct_id=t.nct_id AND tsn.role='lead' AND tsn.company_id='bristol myers squibb'
  JOIN mm ON mm.nct_id=t.nct_id
  WHERE t.nct_id NOT IN (SELECT nct_id FROM celgene_trials)
)
SELECT list(nct_id) FROM bms_true
